notes: litert-community/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct: kimi_linear_48b_a3b_int8_ekv4096.litertlm, a LiteRT-LM conversion of moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct at revision e1df551a (MIT; a 27-layer hybrid decoder: 20 Kimi Delta Attention layers and 7 MLA layers, a dense first layer and 26 mixture-of-experts layers of 256 SiLU experts, 8 per token, plus one shared expert; no thinking mode), text in, text out; written in plain TFLite ops plus LiteRT's moe custom op (one per MoE layer, activation silu) by a graph writer for litert-torch (main 67f11e8): the routed experts (one scale per output row and expert) and every other fully connected layer with a constant weight int8 per channel, the token table fp32; the repo publishes it for the CPU and the GPU (WebGPU); fp32 activations declared; context 4,096 tokens; signatures prefill_128, prefill_1024 and decode; a tokenizer.json converted from the source's tiktoken tokenizer. The moe op with SiLU is in two open LiteRT pull requests (#11192 GPU, #11188 XNNPACK); LiteRT-LM 0.19.2 from PyPI refuses it on both backends, as these two records show; the numbers of the LiteRT-LM built from source with LiteRT #11192 and #11188 (the repo card's Performance and Accuracy tables) are not records: that build has no frame here. Mac Studio rows only: the file is 50.50 GB and no phone was tried. Landed 2026-11-16: litert-community/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct is public and ungated (license mit, base_model moonshotai/Kimi-Linear-48B-A3B-Instruct quantized, library_name litert-lm), upload commit bc471ba2 (2026-11-15 01:45 JST), main b1a6fc381e (the card commit, 2026-11-15T20:14:29.000Z) at the read; the tree's LFS oid and size of kimi_linear_48b_a3b_int8_ekv4096.litertlm = artifact_sha256 and 50498913264 B.
quantization: a graph writer for litert-torch from the bf16 checkpoint (revision e1df551a): each MoE layer's 256 routed experts in one custom op moe with int8 weights per channel (one scale per output row and expert), and every other fully connected layer with a constant weight int8 per channel too (symmetric, min-max: the KDA q, k, v and o projections and its gate and beta projections, the MLA q, compressed key-value input and o projections, the shared experts, the dense first layer, the routers and the output layer; litert-quantizer-nightly 0.12.0.dev20261109); fp32 stay the token table, the norms and the 16 x 16 masks of KDA's chunked prefill; declared fp32 activations; fp32 MLA cache of 4,096 tokens and fp32 delta-rule and convolution states; signatures prefill_128, prefill_1024 and decode
